findings.text: The row headed "Sessions' bytes under /dev/shm" reports the health series' session_scratch_bytes, which reckon/crew/fleet_supervisor.py:1342-1390 computes by walking the per-session scratch directories of the node-local disk (prepare_session_tmp -> /tmp; the sampled paths are /tmp/39486-fleet-1319168/...), not /dev/shm, so the done-when's /dev/shm reading is reported under a heading the instrument never measured.

The 72-hour figures (3,523 samples over 2026-11-19T18:40:11Z to 2026-11-22T18:39:34Z, 191 of 3,200 test samples) come from an earlier invocation of logs/analyse_series.py, while the log now at the cited path is a later run whose 72h block reads 3,525 samples over 19:02:32 to 19:01:06 and 180 of 3,204; the values reproduce from the raw series at the record's own window, but the cited receipt no longer carries them.

The gate's 4,000-sample readability assertion is applied to the whole job, while the delivered 72-hour window holds 3,525 samples, so the check passes the plan's floor on a different population than the record's headline window and cannot fail for the shortfall the record itself reports.

justifications.durability: No file under tests/ changes; the only assertions are the run-directory scripts logs/analyse_series.py:91-113, so nothing in the repository fails if these numbers regress.
justifications.evidence: The gate logs/series-metrics.log records 5 passed at EXIT=0, but the record's session_scratch_bytes row is mislabelled at fragment:40 and the log's 72h block no longer matches the figures at fragment:34.
justifications.fit: The fragment follows the sibling evidence-record idiom and the figure lives under the plan-scoped directory reckon/evidence.py:419 requires.
justifications.goal_fidelity: docs/evidence/fragments/the-fleet-node-stays-inside-its-memory/the-fleet-node-stays-inside-its-memory-s11.html:24 presents the latest 72 hours rather than a post-landing window, which the same file states cannot exist yet.
justifications.reuse: No new mechanism is added; the record consumes the existing figure inventory and evidence reader, and the analysis script reads the health series' own columns.
justifications.scope_discipline: The three changed paths in the diff are a subset of the four declared write paths.

verdicts.diff: Read both commits against 1d23967b383e: the archive section is a pure insertion (0 deleted lines, prior s14 entry intact at archive:22-25), the fragment is a new 63-line file, and the figure is a single 8,309-line SVG.
verdicts.done_when: The done_when asks for seven readings over the 72 hours with a kill count of zero and under one hour at or above 90 % of the limit, and a 4,000-sample floor; the record carries all seven readings but the kill count is 23, so the section stays open and the 72-hour window holds 3,525 samples, below the floor.
verdicts.goal: The goal is the health series of one fleet job over the 72 hours after the other sections land, beside job 1313886; docs/evidence/fragments/the-fleet-node-stays-inside-its-memory/the-fleet-node-stays-inside-its-memory-s11.html:24 presents the latest 72 hours instead, which the same file states cannot exist after the landings yet.
verdicts.manifest: Read; status complete, it names the run directory, the two commits, the 23-kill miss, and the two caveats (no post-landing window, sample floor below 4,000).
verdicts.write_paths: The dispatch declared four paths; the diff's three paths are all inside them, and docs/figures/fleet-node-memory-after is left empty because reckon/evidence.py:419 cites only a manifest figure under docs/figures/<plan>/.
